items.source: A helper that produces a predicate to check whether a Value is a list value and contains only other values with a given type.

Class that defines a tuple of relationship with properties and the connected target
entity.

items.source:
The value for a relationship can be a scalar object (1:1), a collection (1:n), a
map (1:n, but with dynamic relationship types) or a map (1:n) with properties for
each relationship.
items.translation: 关系值可以是标量对象（1:1）、集合（1:n）、具有动态关系类型的映射（1:n），或是为每个关系包含属性的映射（1:n）。

items.source:
The value for a relationship can be a scalar object (1:1), a collection (1:n), a
map (1:n, but with dynamic relationship types) or a map (1:n) with properties for
each relationship. This method unifies the type into something iterable, depending
on the given inverse type.
items.translation: 关系值可以是标量对象（1:1）、集合（1:n）、具有动态关系类型的映射（1:n），或是为每个关系包含属性的映射（1:n）。此方法根据给定的反向类型，将该类型统一为可迭代形式。
